name: Akuma no Musume no Utau Melody
original_name: 悪魔の娘の唄うメロディー
source:
Kiss and screw
the audacious devilette
to make her obedient!
Until she's begging...

A love story ADV with multiple endings;
The meeting and crossed fates of a guy and a devil girl.

The story follows the protagonist who lives alone.
Suddenly, a brazen demon shows up, all spitfire and attitude,
but for some reason romantic toward him. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE175886.html] Dlsite English[/url]]
translation:
亲吻并操弄那位大胆的小恶魔，让她变得顺从！
直到她苦苦哀求……

一部拥有多种结局的恋爱ADV，讲述一个男人与恶魔女孩相遇、命运交错的故事。

主人公独自生活。某天，一个厚颜无耻、脾气火爆的恶魔突然出现，却不知为何对他抱有恋爱感情。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE175886.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
